# CANDIDATE: VIX_INTRADAY_SLOPE_MOMENTUM

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
An intraday rise in VIX1D concurrent with SPY making a lower low signals increasing fear and often precedes a short‑term bounce to the long side. This captures short-term mean reversion in SPY when volatility spikes intraday, exploiting the tendency for fear-induced selling to exhaust and reverse.

## Mechanism
Entry rule: If VIX1D increases by more than 0.6 points over the last two 5‑min bars while SPY records a lower low (5‑min low < prior 5‑min low) on the same period, go long at the close of the second bar; stop placed below that low.  
Exit shape: Chart‑stop at the recent swing low (the low used for entry) or 0.5% risk, TP1 at 1.5R, runner trailed with a chandelier exit (12% off the high‑water mark).  
Regime hint: VIX between 18‑28, time 11:00‑14:00 EST, price above the 50‑EMA on the 15‑min chart indicating a mild underlying uptrend.
